comment: Hand-kept history from before git auto-progress. Generator prepends newer people-facing commits. Do not duplicate a git subject here.

rows.what: Vendor-watch, Setup Strict apps, and ujust install-vendor iterate every vendors{} key. New app = JSON stanza. Heal still HTTPS+checksum only.

rows.what: ujust install-ivpn / install-mullvad / install-proton: WireGuard or Trivalent first; official RPM/repo only after checksum or gpgcheck and an asked extra origin. No store, no Snap, no unverified Flathub.
rows.vs: Easier than hunting RPMs. Stricter than stock Bazaar/Snap.

rows.what: GTK Unwoke setup, app-grid search for locks, You loosened, offline help, repeating signed-reboot nag with a Reboot button, Trivalent as the recommended default.
rows.vs: Easier first day. Same locks. Origin is an explicit pick.

rows.what: USB ISO baker (Titanoboa wrap) plus rebase path. Not Ventoy. Their Secure Boot key.
rows.vs: Empty disk without installing stock first. Their ISO picker is still nicer.

rows.what: Canary + digest pin + post-publish inspect + twice-daily bake + factory-alarm. *-trivalent / Origin / browserless. No Bazaar; Flathub/brew/BT/toolbox/camera off; extra Chromium packs; admin-split.
rows.vs: Hostile-in-the-clear base cannot silently become our GHCR image. Stricter house; every extra lock has a revert.
